review_scope: Bounded Sify July investor-material review and Federal Bank Kochi first-party participant lead. Research only; no admission, normalized lifecycle day or geometry.

baseline.dedup_scope: All selected names and stable keys checked. No Sify Rabale, Sify Siruseri or Federal Bank Kochi campus is selected. Different Sify towers at Rabale would count once. Absence of a name does not establish geographic non-overlap for these held candidates.

rights_scope: Compact attributed factual paraphrases and capture metadata only. Raw publisher HTML, PDF and social images remain temporary and are not redistributed. No source image, source map or map point is selected.

evidence.publisher: Sify Technologies Limited, distributed by GlobeNewswire
evidence.fact: The quarter-ended-June-30 release reports portfolio investments and unnamed capacity delivery, without a named Rabale or Siruseri construction observation.
evidence.scope: Capital expenditure, capacity sales, service delivery and investment commentary do not supply a construction date for either held campus. Financial figures and customer workload claims are not normalized.

evidence.fact: The SISL DC Overview page maps city-level built capacity and distinguishes built IT capacity, operational IT capacity and renewable-power categories. It provides no named construction-stage table for Rabale or Siruseri.
evidence.scope: The image-only table was visually read, not treated as missing because text extraction omitted it. Built minus operational capacity is not construction capacity, city dots are not exact campus locators, and contracted renewable power is not operating IT load. No presentation graphic is redistributed.

evidence.fact: The issuer investor page directly links the exact PDF as IR Update FY 2027 Q1 and separately dates the July 15 results release.
evidence.scope: This closes the PDF's issuer provenance, not an exact PDF upload day or a physical observation date.

evidence.publisher: C V Regi, with an embedded Federal Bank organization post
evidence.publication_date_basis: Public SocialMediaPosting JSON-LD datePublished, not the relative age or activity-number decoding.
evidence.license: unknown; no open redistribution license verified
evidence.fact: A first-person participant describes a recent Federal Bank green-data-centre foundation ceremony; the embedded bank post identifies the proposed office in Kochi.
evidence.scope: Recently does not supply the actual ceremony day. The post is labelled edited; no original version or edit timestamp is captured. Publication of the participant post does not date the embedded bank post or the ceremony. Public press copies dated July 8-11 likewise do not establish an exact event day. No precise parcel, street address or reusable geometry is given. Images were not selected or visually reviewed.
